SELECT u.*, d.dept_NAME AS dept_name, GROUP_CONCAT( r.role_NAME order by r.role_sort) AS roleNames, GROUP_CONCAT( r.role_id order by r.role_sort) AS roleId FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON u.user_id = sur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON sur.role_id = r.role_id
u.user_deleted = 0
AND u.username != 'admin'
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.keywords},'%') OR u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.keywords},'%') OR u.user_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.keywords},'%') )
AND u.user_status = #{queryParams.status}
AND concat(',',concat(d.dept_tree_path,',',d.dept_id),',') like concat('%,',#{queryParams.deptId},',%')
GROUP BY u.user_id
